_comment: load_bearing_no_subject is the count of claims that assert a SECURITY control and name
nothing a machine can resolve: no code-quoted symbol, no path, no env var. It is where two
of the eleven original defects lived - the compose comment attributing rate limiting to
redis while nothing constructed RedisCounter, and the fourteen docstrings saying a
credential was never logged without naming what made that so.
This number MAY ONLY DECREASE. That is the goal document's own and only success criterion,
and until this file existed nothing measured it.
Lowering it means giving a claim a resolvable subject, not deleting the claim. Deleting a
true claim to make a number fall would be the worst possible use of this file, and the
reason the summary prints the ORDINARY residue beside it is so that rewording a claim to
dodge the phrase list is visible as a rise on the other side of the ledger.
note: First measurement. 1297 claims enumerated across boltrig/ docstrings, comments and the compose files; 248 name a subject production code reaches, 236 load-bearing ones name nothing at all. No SUBJECT-ABSENT rows, which is the unwired-claims gate having already cleared that class.
